command.cmd: $s2bAllProcesses=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; @{own_remaining=@($s2bAllProcesses | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -in @(13684,14672) } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine); relevant_processes=@($s2bAllProcesses | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^vitis|^vivado[.]exe$|^arm-none|^hw_server|^cs_server|^xsdb|^xelab|^xsim' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine); memory=(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object TotalVisibleMemorySize,FreePhysicalMemory); checked_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
